v4_baseline.root_cause: Pretrained MNLI head wiped + length mismatch caused ranking inversion on short distractors.

ablation_a_head_only.scientific_conclusion: Warm-starting head prevents total inversion on short claims (AUROC 0.75 vs 0.39 in V4), but without multi-genre balance, evidence dilution limits generalization.

ablation_b_data_only.scientific_conclusion: Balanced data prevents directional bias, but wiping the pretrained classification head destroys the 3-class MNLI logical prior, degrading sample efficiency.

v5_full.configuration: Full V5 (Warm Head + Balanced Multi-Genre Data)

ablation_analysis.head_contribution: Preserving the MNLI head weights prevents ranking inversion (+0.3307 AUROC on short claims), recovering contradiction detection from 0% to 40%.
ablation_analysis.data_contribution: Multi-genre data balancing extends context window to long arguments (+0.2500 AUROC on LLM stratum), preventing false alarms from topic distractors.
ablation_analysis.synergistic_gain: Combining both interventions produces a +0.5133 Macro AUROC jump (0.3907 -> 0.9040), proving both components are strictly necessary.
